FULL.notes:
[chunk 1/5] Source: Meta 10-Q for Q2 2025 (filed 2025-07-31). KEY FINDINGS: (1) CAPEX_ROI_GAP: Meta deployed $29.5B capex in H1 2025 (vs $14.6B in H1 2024), with construction in progress now at $35.9B; aggressive capex ramp without disclosed matching customer contracts or revenue commitments for AI infrastructure. (2) COST_OPACITY: Useful life extension of servers/network assets from prior assumption to 5.5 years effective Jan 1, 2025 added $1.34B to net income in H1 2025 (52¢ per share); this accounting change is material to earnings and masks true capex efficiency. (3) CIRCULARITY / HIDDEN LEVERAGE: $13.79B investment in Scale AI (June 2025) structured as non-voting minority with no significant influence; Meta obtains neither board seat nor operational control despite massive capital commitment; potential for opaque pricing relationships and supplier lock-in. (4) OFF-BALANCE PROJECT FINANCE: $3.26B in held-for-sale data center assets (mostly construction in progress + land) to be contributed to third party for co-development; disposal announced June 2025 for completion within 12 months; structure suggests risk transfer/risk-sharing arrangement not fully consolidated. (5) NON-MARKETABLE EQUITY: Total non-marketable equity investments surged from $6.07B (Dec 2024) to $21.99B (June 2025), driven by Scale AI; $2.02B in equity-method VIEs with max exposure ~$1.98B; subsequent tender offers of up to $3.0B to acquire additional VIE stakes suggest hidden leverage and future capital calls. No customer concentration data or supplier dependency disclosures in Item 1 narrative section provided; routine financial metrics dominate.
[chunk 2/5] Meta 10-Q H1 2025: SIFI-material signals extracted from legal, business, and capex sections. Key findings: (1) REVENUE_CONCENTRATION — 99%+ from advertising with critical platform/regulatory dependencies on Apple iOS tracking limits and evolving GDPR/DMA/DSA rules. Apple's 2021 iOS changes are explicitly cited as ongoing negative. (2) CAPEX_ROI_GAP — Reality Labs segment burned $8.74B in H1 2025 with no near-term revenue path; company explicitly states 10-year horizon for monetization and expects full-year 2025 RL losses to increase. (3) OFF-BALANCE_LEVERAGE — $52.56B in uncommenced operating leases (mostly data centers, 2025–2034) + $27.95B non-cancelable contractual commitments ($18.3B due in 2025) = $80.51B in committed future obligations not yet on balance sheet. (4) Legal/regulatory overhang: extensive privacy litigation, FTC consent order disputes (ongoing as of July 2025), EU competition/DSA/DMA fines and investigations, youth-related product liability claims with trials scheduled Nov 2025–2026. No material related-party transactions or hidden circularity detected in this section; regulatory risk is the dominant SIFI signal. No private AI labs mentioned in this excerpt.
